Comment.value: Shifter initiation reagent (roadmap: shifter-quest). Given by the still pool at Beorn's steading (q_shf_pool OnUsed, instance tag ShfBeornPool) only when the looking PC wears another skin (QSHF_IsShifted in q_shf_inc -- an EFFECT_TYPE_POLYMORPH effect is active: shifter shapes, druid wild shape, any polymorph; the module's proven detection idiom from dmfi_dmw_inc.nss). GetItemPossessedBy check at Halmir's turn-in (q_shf_c_rdy). Plot + cursed so it cannot be sold, dropped or traded; q_shf_finish clears the plot flag and consumes it. BaseItem 24 + ModelPart1 44 copied from the sibling reagents (q_dwd_shard et al).

value.0: A tuft of coarse dark hair, warmer and heavier than hair has any right to be, given up by the still pool at Beorn's steading in the shadow of the Carrock. The water parts with it only for one who looks in wearing another skin -- wild-shaped, another face over their own -- and it cannot be set down, sold, or handed off. The skin-changers call it a tuft of the first skin: proof the trial was taken in a borrowed shape, and it means nothing to anyone but Halmir the Grey, who keeps the skin-changers' page on his roll of the old orders.
